paper_title: $M^3EL$ A Multi-task Multi-topic Dataset for Multi-modal Entity Linking
caption: : Entity topic distribution.
model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of entity topics. The chart is divided into six slices, representing distinct topics, and includes a legend positioned to the left of the chart identifying the categories. The slices are visually arranged in descending order of size. The largest slice, representing "Moive", is colored dark blue and occupies approximately 41.2% of the pie chart. Following that, the “Common” slice is colored light blue at 14.9%, "Person" is colored pink at 14.9%, "Book" is colored yellow at 9.1%, “Sport” is colored light green at 4.3% and finally “Topics” is colored purple and represents 30.5% of the chart. Percentage labels are displayed directly within each slice.
